items.title: Understanding Consequences of Unethical Digital Behavior

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Understanding Consequences of Unethical Digital Behavior under 9.5 as printed (PDF 135, printed 131).

blocks.text: Unethical digital behavior can include hacking, spreading false information, or cyberbullying. Such actions can cause harm, damage reputations, and lead to legal consequences. Even small actions online may have significant effects. Understanding the outcomes of unethical behavior encourages responsible digital conduct. Maintaining ethical standards ensures a safer and more trustworthy online environment.
